summary: Addresses the growth of RTCP reception reports when several RTP streams are sent in one session, since each source normally reports on every other source. It defines a way to group reception statistics and other feedback so the volume grows with the number of endpoints, not streams. It is standards-track.

eli5.summary: If every person in a room had to write a report about every other person, there would be mountains of paper. This document lets people share reports in groups so there is far less to write.

questions: how to reduce rtcp reports with many ssrcs
